items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: And Ellie Begold, he was on the drum. Anyhow, there was about five.

ctx.x: Well, they had this on account of hard to find people, you know, musicians. I see. They had to keep what kind of kids. And there's one more I could remember. See, Parker, Hoyford Smith, I called them to you. They had a piano too, huh? And they had a piano. I can't remember his name. It was a man. I don't remember anything. And Ellie Begold, he was on the drum. Anyhow, there was about five. That's about all I remember. That makes fun, yeah. Yeah.
You said that was, did you, was that a reading band, or yes, a jazz band?
